about: Volter Harness's Telegram channel as it ships (supercode 62620578c014, sdk/orchestrator/adapters/chat-sdk.mjs): the unchanged Chat SDK (chat 4.39.0, @chat-adapter/telegram 4.39.0, @chat-adapter/state-memory 4.39.0) polls with the bot token the World's credential door issues as TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN (getMe, deleteWebhook, getUpdates), hears Ada's private message (the World's people and messages doors stand in for the Telegram app) and answers in her chat (thread.post: sendMessage). The readback reads her private chat back (getChat) without polling or sending.
